purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19003 (FBS-221) driving rcf build bundle --next and rcf build backstop adopt through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-221 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the backstop.
title: Verified backstop on rcf build bundle --next: refusal on complete-unverified specs from fromBuildOrder, --allow-unverified override recorded, absent backstop inert, rcf build backstop adopt

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next with an FBS at or above backstop fromBuildOrder at complete exits 4 with "backstop: <k> merged spec(s) complete and not verified: <ids>; run rcf build finalise <id> or pass --allow-unverified "<reason>"" and emits no bundle
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20201-4: a record at B with exitCode 1 and tap fail 3 refuses bundle --next, the explicit bundle FBS-002 and an amend bundle with exit 4 "backstop: base suite red at <B7>: exit 1, 3 failing; no Build starts until the RCF suite is green on the base"

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next --allow-unverified "<reason>" emits the bundle, appends { reason, by, at, unverifiedFbsIds } to backstop.overrides in rcf/define/backstop.json and prints "backstop overridden: <reason>" on stdout; an empty reason exits 2
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20203-3: bundle --next --allow-unverified "hotfix" --base-suite <file> exits 2 with the retired-flag usage line and emits no bundle

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next with no rcf/define/backstop.json, or one whose complete FBS all have buildOrder below fromBuildOrder, does not refuse and the bundle behaves as before (exit 0, stdout byte-identical to the run with no backstop file)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20203-1: with rcf/define/backstop.json (fromBuildOrder 1) and a complete-not-verified spec above it, bundle --next with a green record exits 0, emits the bundle and carries exactly one retired-file warn line

testCases.description: rcf build backstop adopt --from FBS-218 exits 0 writing rcf/define/backstop.json { fromBuildOrder: 218, adoptedAt, adoptedBy }; an unknown FBS id exits 3 and a missing --from exits 2
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20203-2: rcf build backstop adopt --from FBS-001 exits 2 with the retired-adopt usage line and writes no file

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next never emits a bundle while the backstop refuses unless --allow-unverified carries a non-empty reason, and the override never changes any FBS executionStatus
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20201-5: no flag emits a bundle on a red or missing record (--override, --strict, --format), and the backstop never reads verified: every earlier spec complete and none verified with a green record bundles

testCases.description: with the backstop adopted from FBS-001, bundle --next refuses while FBS-001 is complete, the real rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run <ref> writes verified, and bundle --next then hands out FBS-002 with no override recorded
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-base-suite.test.js::AC-20201-4: a record at B with exitCode 1 and tap fail 3 refuses bundle --next, the explicit bundle FBS-002 and an amend bundle with exit 4 "backstop: base suite red at <B7>: exit 1, 3 failing; no Build starts until the RCF suite is green on the base"
